title: Operator precedence
statement: Engine shall implement operator precedence and reference operators consistent with Excel worksheet semantics.
notes: Use ABNF + precedence guidance as combined anchor.

title: Reference operator set
statement: Engine shall accept range (`:`), union (`,`), and intersection (space) reference operators in worksheet formulas.
notes: Intersection parsing must be explicitly tested.

title: Implicit intersection operator
statement: Engine shall implement `@` implicit intersection semantics and migration-compatible behavior.
notes: Behavior must be stable under modern dynamic-array context.

title: Spilled range operator
statement: Engine shall implement `#` spilled-range operator behavior for dynamic-array results.
notes: Includes dependent reference updates after spill resize.

title: Dynamic-array spill semantics
statement: Engine shall implement spill placement/blocking semantics and visible spill errors.
notes: Spill blockage and resize scenarios are required conformance lanes.

title: Formula grammar anchor
statement: Parser grammar shall remain aligned to formal MS-XLSX formula grammar coverage where applicable.
notes: Do not widen grammar silently without explicit compatibility note; external-reference open-state policy remains build-scoped provisional.

title: Cell formula constraints
statement: Cell-formula storage/normalization constraints shall match worksheet-level expectations from formal sources.
notes: Normalization behavior should be preserved in serialization paths.

title: Name resolution rules
statement: Name scope, syntax, and precedence shall follow Excel naming rules for workbook/sheet contexts.
notes: Include collision and scope-shadowing tests.

title: Structured references in formulas
statement: Structured-reference grammar and usage in formulas shall be supported as first-class formula constructs.
notes: Table formulas are not treated as UI-only sugar.

title: Parser ambiguity: double-comma SUM
statement: Behavior for `=SUM(A1,,B1)` shall be treated as build-scoped provisional compatibility behavior until broader evidence converges.
notes: Counter-signal retained; do not hard-code rejection without policy decision.

title: Dot-field parse/eval probe
statement: Dot-field form acceptance and evaluation outcomes shall be treated as provisional and constrained by linked-data-type semantics.
notes: Requires dedicated linked-data fixture coverage.

title: Function call admission vs runtime error boundary
statement: Function-call conformance shall explicitly distinguish parse-time formula rejection from accepted-formula runtime error outcomes, including required-argument omission and array-lifted element error behavior.
notes: Current public sources are thin for per-function coercion/array semantics; empirical matrix is mandatory.

title: Function universe baseline
statement: In-scope built-in worksheet function set shall match the 500-function baseline catalog from prior run corpus.
notes: Catalog source: research run function_catalog_full.csv.

title: Tiered classification baseline
statement: Interesting-function triage shall use the existing 5-tier model as compatibility test prioritization guidance.
notes: Tier model drives depth and probe cadence.

title: Tier-5 critical semantics
statement: Tier-5 critical functions (`INDIRECT`,`OFFSET`,`NOW`,`TODAY`,`RTD`) shall have explicit semantic and empirical conformance lanes.
notes: Critical-risk functions require strongest evidence discipline.

title: CUBE family inclusion
statement: CUBE worksheet functions shall be included in conformance scope with context-aware caveats; MDX internals remain out of scope.
notes: List completeness is required even when depth is deferred.

title: Functional formula features
statement: LET/LAMBDA and helper-family behavior shall be supported and tested as distinct high-interest semantics.
notes: Helper-family conformance is required for modern formula workloads.

title: Dynamic-array generator features
statement: Dynamic-array generation functions (for example RANDARRAY/SEQUENCE/GROUPBY/PIVOTBY family) shall be compatibility-tracked.
notes: Availability and behavior can vary by build/channel.

title: External dependency function caveats
statement: Externally dependent functions (RTD, WEBSERVICE/FILTERXML/STOCKHISTORY, CUBE) shall be explicitly capability-gated.
notes: Capability profile must expose unavailable/not-supported states.

title: Volatility and invalidation classes
statement: Volatile vs non-volatile vs externally-invalidated behavior shall be tested as separate invalidation paths.
notes: Separate invalidation lanes are required for deterministic debugging.

title: SUMIF mixed-signal handling
statement: SUMIF reason-code behavior is provisional and shall remain an explicit open compatibility lane.
notes: Do not assume stable classification until expanded evidence exists.

title: RTD lifecycle baseline
statement: RTD lifecycle baseline behavior from empirical wave1 is a required conformance lane for supported platforms.
notes: Includes close/open and missing-progid controls.

title: Dynamic-array mixed-type counter-signals
statement: Mixed-type dynamic-array counter-signals shall remain provisional and tracked as explicit unresolved compatibility lanes.
notes: Retained counter-signals from unresolved wave2 replay.

title: Type predicates
statement: TYPE and IS-family predicates shall align with worksheet-visible value category behavior.
notes: Include arrays, errors, text, logical, numeric fixtures.

title: N conversion
statement: N conversion behavior shall match documented conversion table semantics.
notes: Include booleans, text, dates, errors.

title: VALUE conversion
statement: VALUE conversion shall follow documented text-to-number semantics with locale caveat handling.
notes: Locale axis required in conformance matrix.

title: VALUETOTEXT conversion
statement: VALUETOTEXT behavior shall be implemented with mode-aware rendering semantics.
notes: Error rendering and mode differences required.

title: Linked data types and fields
statement: Linked/compound data type field access semantics shall follow worksheet-visible behavior.
notes: Extended types kept shallow but explicit.

title: Date system semantics
statement: 1900/1904 date-system behavior and workbook transfer semantics shall be implemented and empirically validated.
notes: Includes formula copy vs raw serial copy distinction.

title: Operator coercion baseline
statement: Operator coercion behavior shall follow current truth-table baseline for arithmetic/comparison/concat contexts.
notes: Coercion matrix rows must be versioned.

title: Aggregate range coercion counter-signal
statement: Mixed text+numeric range coercion for aggregates remains provisional and must stay explicitly tracked.
notes: Retained mismatch rows CW1-022/024/025.

title: Nested precedence/coercion edge cases
statement: Nested/unary precedence and compatibility syntax ambiguities shall remain explicit empirical conformance lanes.
notes: Use dedicated ambiguity fixture corpus.

title: Structured-reference syntax
statement: Table structured-reference syntax shall be supported in formula parse/eval pipelines.
notes: Includes `[#This Row]` and column selectors.

title: Calculated columns and autofill
statement: Calculated columns shall auto-propagate and remain stable under append/edit operations.
notes: Desktop and web caveat coverage required.

title: Auto-expand behavior
statement: Table auto-expand behavior shall be implemented for row growth with formula continuation semantics.
notes: Growth operations must preserve table semantics.

title: Structured-reference spill interactions
statement: Structured-reference and spill interactions are required conformance lanes with explicit provisional mismatch tracking.
notes: TBW1-002 retained as unresolved counter-signal.

title: Platform caveats for tables
statement: Table behavior differences across desktop/web shall be represented as explicit caveat metadata, not silent divergence.
notes: Union behavior target with caveat ledger.

title: Number format grammar
statement: Number format code grammar shall implement worksheet-visible behavior, including formal ABNF-backed lanes and international-profile adjustments.
notes: Custom format sections must be validated; locale-profile variants are required.

title: Rendered formatting behavior
statement: Rendered text outcomes for canonical custom/built-in formats shall be tested in conformance fixtures.
notes: Include date/time and text section behavior.

title: Merge/unmerge behavior
statement: Merge/unmerge operations shall preserve worksheet-visible constraints and deterministic outcomes.
notes: Include interactions with formulas and spills; direct merge-state capture now anchored empirically.

title: Conditional formatting baseline
statement: CF rule application, overlap, and priority ordering shall follow captured baseline behavior and formal precedence-order anchors.
notes: Stop-if-true and priority transitions required.

title: CF spill-target mismatch lane
statement: CF behavior on spill targets remains provisional and must stay in explicit mismatch lane.
notes: Do not collapse this into normative truth yet.

title: Formatting limits
statement: Formatting implementation shall respect documented Excel limits relevant to this scope.
notes: Limits are part of compatibility contract.

title: Number-format underspec policy
statement: Where formal sources leave `formatCode` bounds/content and `numFmtId` defaults unspecified, the engine shall keep explicit policy lanes and empirical closure tests.
notes: Do not hide underspecified behavior behind implicit defaults.

title: Conditional-format formula grammar restrictions
statement: Conditional-format formula parsing/evaluation shall enforce the formal restriction lane (no array constants, no structured references, no union/intersection operators, no 3-D references).
notes: Capture any Excel build divergence as explicit provisional caveat, not parser drift.

title: Style hierarchy model
statement: Formatting implementation shall model workbook style tables (`cellStyleXfs`/`cellXfs`/style index) and differential-format overlays as explicit layers.
notes: Do not collapse style tables into ad-hoc per-cell state.

title: Style precedence conflict lanes
statement: Effective-format precedence across row/column/cell/table/conditional-format layers shall be represented and tested as explicit conflict lanes.
notes: Keep unresolved precedence collisions explicit until empirical closure.

title: Defaults origin policy
statement: Default formatting behavior (font/size/base style/sheet defaults) shall be treated as workbook/profile-derived and validated empirically per environment profile.
notes: Avoid hardcoded default claims without profile-bound evidence.

title: Locale formatting profile interaction
statement: Locale/regional profile effects on format parse/render behavior shall be represented as explicit conformance axes.
notes: Locale profile must not silently redefine core value semantics.

title: Formula-visible formatting introspection
statement: Formatting-observation behavior through formula functions (`TEXT`, `CELL`, `INFO`) shall be explicitly characterized and tested.
notes: Distinguish explicit format-string conversion from ambient-style introspection.

title: Conditional-format visibility to formulas
statement: Whether conditional-format effective style is formula-observable shall remain an explicit provisional lane until bounded by empirical evidence.
notes: Document any supported legacy compatibility pathways separately from core formula semantics.

title: Compatibility versions
statement: Workbook compatibility-version behavior shall be treated as a first-class conformance axis.
notes: Version-sensitive behavior must be auditable.

title: Channel/release awareness
statement: Function and behavior availability shall be tracked against channel/release metadata where applicable.
notes: Do not assume simultaneous rollout across channels.

title: Platform capability profile
statement: Conformance runs shall emit platform capability profile and applies-to mapping artifacts.
notes: Union-first target with explicit caveat rows.

title: Empirical environment provenance
statement: Empirical-backed requirements shall include Excel version/build/hash and runner/tool metadata.
notes: Required for reproducibility and conflict triage.

title: Refresh and drift control
statement: Drift-sensitive behaviors shall be rechecked on dated cadence with explicit regression logging.
notes: Refresh loop is required for unstable surfaces.

title: Evidence id requirement
statement: Every conformance requirement shall cite one or more evidence ids resolvable via SOURCE_BINDINGS.
notes: No uncited requirement rows.

title: Spec/empirical dual-source model
statement: Conformance source model shall support spec-derived and empirical-derived evidence lineages.
notes: Use SPEC/EMP lineage consistently.

title: Conflict retention rule
statement: When empirical signals conflict with spec interpretation, both shall remain explicit until reconciled.
notes: No silent overwrites.

title: Provisional gating
statement: Requirements marked provisional shall not be used as sole release gate without explicit waiver.
notes: Provisional status must remain visible.

title: Executable traceability
statement: Conformance tests shall record requirement id bindings in emitted evidence bundles.
notes: Requirement-to-test trace matrix is mandatory.

title: Transactional seam sequence
statement: FEC/F3E implementations shall enforce deterministic `prepare -> open_session/capability_view -> execute -> commit` lifecycle sequencing with explicit transition checks.
notes: Aligned to current redesign seam contract.

title: Session-bound capability gating
statement: Evaluation shall observe only capabilities declared by expression/function contracts and accepted in the active session capability view.
notes: Capability decisions must be commit-validated.

title: Token and dependency delta lifecycle
statement: Formula/session tokens and runtime dependency deltas shall be versioned, replay-observable, and deterministically retired/replaced on semantic changes.
notes: No hidden token reuse or untracked dependency delta mutation.

title: Typed reject and conflict semantics
statement: Commit reject outcomes shall map to stable machine-typed classes with deterministic conflict context (token/snapshot/capability) suitable for replay diagnostics.
notes: Reject semantics are protocol surface, not logging-only text.

title: ID-first seam identity
statement: FEC/F3E seam payloads shall use explicit stable typed identities (`formula_stable_id`, `FecNameId`, `FecRangeId`) rather than label strings as dependency identity.
notes: Names/labels remain metadata only in traces.

title: Deterministic resolver/reject mapping
statement: Reference and commit resolver failures shall map to deterministic version-scoped reject behavior with explicit structured context.
notes: Resolver fallbacks must be explicit policy, never silent coercion.

title: Capability-denial behavior
statement: When capability policy denies required facilities, evaluation and commit shall produce explicit deterministic denial outcomes and diagnostics.
notes: Capability denial is a first-class conformance surface.

title: Trace/provenance metadata contract
statement: Seam outcomes used by scheduler/replay tooling shall carry provenance metadata (trace schema version, delta provenance, and identity context) sufficient for deterministic triage.
notes: Trace schema contract is mandatory for cross-engine replay audits.

title: Numeric edge observability in formula-only evaluation
statement: Formula-only evaluation lanes shall define version-scoped behavior for -0, infinities, NaN, and subnormal inputs/outputs.
notes: Requires dedicated empirical replay matrix before validation.

title: Numeric edge observability in sheet materialization
statement: Sheet materialization lanes (cell storage/display/error surfacing) shall define version-scoped behavior for -0, infinities, NaN, and subnormals.
notes: Materialization outcomes must be replay-bound with build metadata.

title: Numeric edge observability in reference reuse
statement: Reference reuse lanes shall define how numeric edge values (-0, infinities, NaN, subnormals) propagate when consumed through references/ranges.
notes: Includes dereference/coercion boundaries and array propagation behavior.

title: Numeric edge observability in interop ingestion
statement: Interop ingestion lanes shall define version-scoped handling for incoming numeric edge values (-0, infinities, NaN, subnormals) with explicit replay obligations.
notes: Ingestion differences must be traceable to source format/profile and build metadata.
